title: Juliet Quartermain Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Ruby Mottled Foliage
description:
Stunning Ruby & Burgundy Foliage for Borders & Containers!
KEY FEATURES
• Striking ruby and burgundy mottled foliage
• Easy to grow and propagate
• Ideal for borders, containers, and patio displays
• Can be overwintered indoors as a houseplant
• Adds vibrant colour to any setting
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides 'Juliet Quartermain'
Colour: Ruby, Burgundy, Kale Red (Foliage)
Season: Spring, Summer, Autumn (Foliage Interest)
Growth Habit: Bushy
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun, Partial shade
Soil: Chalk, Clay, Loam, Sand (Moist but well-drained)
Watering: Keep soil moist, but avoid overly damp conditions
Spacing: 35-50 cm
Height: 0.5-1 metres
Spread: 0.5-1 metres
Hardiness: H1C (Can be grown outside in summer, 5-10°C)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant outdoors after all risk of frost has passed, in a sheltered position.
• Use a humus-rich, moist but well-drained soil or high-quality potting compost.
• Pinch out stem tips to encourage bushier growth and remove flower spikes to maintain foliage vibrancy.
• Feed monthly with a water-soluble fertiliser for lush growth and rich leaf colours.
• Bring indoors before the first frost to overwinter as a houseplant, providing bright, filtered light.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
1x Mini Plug Plant
DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
